shard.title: Subject: Leisure
shard.basis: the publisher's subject list, from gssrdoc in the current release (7224r3a)

questions.text:
Suppose you could change the way you spend your time, spending more on some things and less on others. Which of these things on the following list would you like to spend more time on, which would you like to spend less time on, and which would you like to spend the same amount of time as now? 
F. Time to relax?
